sections.h2: Most medicine sales sit outside any price ceiling

chart.title: Non-scheduled medicines, 82% of sales by value, have no ceiling price
chart.sub: Share of India's medicine sales by value, %.
chart.source: Lok Sabha Standing Committee, Dec 2025; DPCO 2013.
chart.accent: Non-scheduled, no ceiling price or margin limit
rows: Non-scheduled, no ceiling price or margin limit

sections.means: The regulator's only rule for these medicines is a cap of 10% a year on MRP rises, and the launch price is left to the company.
sections.todo: Set a standing trade-margin framework that reaches beyond the named lists, as the committee asked.

sections.h2: Common packs were marked up by 920% to 953% over stockist price

chart.title: Two packs cited by the committee carried markups of 920% and 953%
chart.sub: Markup of MRP over stockist price, %.
chart.source: Lok Sabha Standing Committee, Dec 2025. Brands not named.

sections.means: The public cannot see stockist prices, so these margins are invisible to buyers.
sections.todo: Publish stockist prices alongside MRPs so that buyers can see the margin they are paying.

sections.h2: Earlier caps cut cancer-drug prices by 73% to 87% where they applied

chart.title: Named-list caps cut cancer-drug MRPs sharply, but each applied only to its list
chart.sub: Cut in MRP after the 2019 cap, %.

sections.means: Each cap was issued under emergency powers for a named list, and the 2026 list covers only cancer drugs.
sections.todo: Turn trade-margin rationalisation into a standing part of the price-control order with a set timeline.

sections.h2: Only 16% of overcharging demanded by March 2026 has been recovered

chart.title: Rs 10,030 crore was demanded by March 2026, but only Rs 1,582 crore recovered
chart.sub: Overcharging demanded and recovered, cumulative, Rs crore.
chart.source: Parliamentary replies; March 2026 figure from an explainer of official data.

sections.means: Most of the unrecovered sum is tied up in court, some cases for more than 20 years.
sections.todo: Adopt the committee's fast-track mechanism for cases outside court and a legal cell inside the regulator.
